name: Code-Driven Video (HyperFrames)
desc: Code-driven video production with HyperFrames: write HTML compositions, animate with keyframes, add audio, and render promo/explainer/title videos from a single agent prompt.
desc_zh: 代码化视频生产（HyperFrames）：用 HTML 写视频合成、关键帧动画、音轨与批量渲染，从一句话生成产品宣传片/讲解片/标题卡（上游装机 47~50 万）。
